NOT a missed resolution - the freeze grade correctly had Hillstead as QB1 (magazine + CFBD both had him); it was simply conservative (L, 'limited recent sample'). rationale_bullets: The freeze grade already had Hillstead as QB1 (correct - the magazine AND the CFBD portal pull both had him); it graded 32 L on 'unproven at USU / limited recent sample.' This pass is a CONFIDENCE/LEVEL refinement, NOT a corrected miss.

Two things push it up: (a) he was officially NAMED starter 2026-04-20 and Mendenhall calls QB the team's 'strongest position'; (b) his prior production was under-weighted - 4 starts, 1,062 yds, 11 TD as a '23 USU true freshman (a full productive season, not just the '399 vs JMU / 5 recent snaps' the grade cited).

34 (M, up from 32 L): the prior-production evidence puts him AT the proven-G5-starter tier (~New Mexico/San Diego State 34) rather than below it; M because the job is settled with a staff endorsement. The 2-yr recent-rep gap is why it's not higher.
